feature1.title: Monetize Your Passion
feature1.desc: Earn money with monthly subscriptions, tips, and pay-per-view (PPV) content. You set the price, you keep most of it.

feature2.title: Direct Connection
feature2.desc: Forget the algorithms. Talk directly to your fans through a private feed, stories, and direct messaging. Build a real community.

feature3.title: Powerful Tools
feature3.desc: Analyze your stats, schedule your posts, and get content ideas with our integrated AI. All the tools you need to grow.

feature4.title: Security and Control
feature4.desc: You decide who sees your content. With our age verification and robust moderation tools, you create in a safe environment.

feature1.title: Exclusive Access
feature1.desc: Unlock content you won't find anywhere else. Directly support the creators you admire and be part of their journey.

feature2.title: Real Interaction
feature2.desc: Comment, like, and send direct messages. On TheFreed, you're not just a number, you're part of a community.

feature3.title: Discover Without Limits
feature3.desc: Explore a galaxy of artists, podcasters, musicians, and more. Our discovery feed is designed for you to find your next obsession.
